The '''Kovor system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Koradin sector/Legends|Koradin sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kovor]].
